t: Din ereb pesach shechal lihyot beshabbat
s: Din ereb pesach shechal lihyot beshabbat ubo k' seipim: y"d benisan shechal lihyot beshabbat, kevan shei epshar libdoq belel shabbat, shehare asur letaltel et hanner libdoq leoro, vegam bayyom i epshar libdoq kemo shennitbaer besiman tl"g, lepikak maqdimin hakkol libdoq belel shishshi, shehu lel y"g, umebarekin "al biur chametz", umebattelin kol chametz shennishar birshuto shello matzeu bibdiqa zo, venizharin bechametz hannimtza babbediqa ubechametz shemmeshayyerin laakila lehannicho bemaqom mutzna, shello yigreru mimmennu qetannim o sheratzim, kemo shennitbaer besiman tl"d:

Ubeyom ereb shabbat tzarik lebaer kol hechametz shebbirshuto, velo yeshayyer mimmennu raq mazon b' seudot leshabbat, abal seuda shelishit, kevan shezzemannah hu achar chatzot hayyom, i epshar leoklah raq matztza ashira, dehaynu matztza shennillosha beyayin o shemen o debash o chalab o shear mashqin ume perot, shekkol ellu enan niqrain "lechem oni", veen adam yotze bahen yede chobat akilat matztza bepesach, ulepikak muttar leoklo beereb pesach. Abal kol matztza sheadam yotze bah yede chobato bepesach asur leoklah beereb pesach, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ta"a:

Ubimdinot ellu sheen nohagin kelal leekol matztza ashira beereb pesach mishshaa h' vaelak mittaam sheyyitbaer besiman ts"b — yeqayyemu seuda shelishit bebasar vedagim vekayyotze bahen bishar mine liptan, shehare yesh omerim shebbidbarim ellu adam yotze yede chobat seuda shelishit bekol shabbetot hashshana, kemo shennitbaer besiman rtz"a:

Veim en lo mine liptan — yeqayyemenna bemine perot, shehare yesh omerim sheggam bazeh yotze yede chobat seuda shelishit, kemo shennitbaer sham. Vehaya rauy leqayyemah bematztza mebushshelet shello nimmocha legamre bebishshulah ella perusoteha qayyamin, dehaynu sheyyesh bekol echad mehen kezayit beinyan shemmebarekin alehen "hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon, veyakol leqayyem bah seuda g' ledibre hakkol, shehare muttar leoklah beereb pesach, kevan sheen adam yotze yede chobato bepesach bematztza mebushshelet (kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"a), ella sheen nohagin laasot ken. Umi shennoheg ken, veken bimqomot shennohagin leekol matztza ashira — tzerikin lizzaher sheyyokal seuda g' zo qodem shaa asirit, shemmikkan vaelak asur leekol pat ad haereb, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ta"a:

Keshemmebaer hechametz beereb shabbat, ap al pi shemmin haddin yakol lebaaro samuk lachasheka veen tzarik lebaaro qodem chatzot hayyom kemo bishar kol hashshanim, shehare muttar leoklo ad lemachar beshaa h', mikkol maqom tob lizzaher lebaaro beereb shabbat qodem chatzot hayyom, kede shello yabou litot bishar shanim lebaer gam ken achar chatzot hayyom beereb pesach:

Abal en tzarik lebattel beereb shabbat bishat habbiur kemo bishar hashshanim, shehare kebar bittel belel v' kol hechametz shebbirshuto shello metzao veeno yodea mimmennu, umah sheyyesh birshuto min hechametz hayyadua lo i epshar lo lebattelo beereb shabbat, shehare tzarik hu leekol mimmennu beshabbat:
Yesh lehazhir lashsheliach tzibbur shello yaarik bitpilla beshabbat shacharit, mishshum akilat chametz, shello yabou lide issur:

En lebashshel leshabbat zeh mine haripot o mine qemachim o shear kol mine tabshilin sheddarkan liddabeq baqqedera o baqqeara, kede shello yitztarek lehadichan beshabbat achar gemar haakila lehasir et hechametz haddabuq bahen, shehare hadacha zo enah letzorek hashshabbat, veasur lehadiach kelim shello letzorek hashshabbat, kemo shennitbaer besiman shk"g. Veim abar ubishshel minim ellu venidbequ bakkelim beinyan shei epshar leqannecham heteb shello yishshaer bahem meuma — muttar lehadicham beshabbat, kevan sheyyesh bahadacha zo tzorek mitzva, lehaabir hechametz mehakkeli kede lebaaro. Vetob lehadicham apillu en bahem ella meat chametz beinyan sheen tzarik lebaaro meiqqar haddin, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"b. Abal im epshar lo leqannecham heteb — asur lehadicham beshabbat:

Achar sheggamar milleekol seudat shacharit beshabbat zeh qodem shaa chamishit, yenaer heteb hammappa sheakelu aleha min happerurin haddaqqin shennisharu bah, vehaqqederot vehaqqearot vehakkappot ushear hakkelim shennishtammesh bahen chametz yeqannechem heteb beetzbao shello yishshaer bahem chametz beayin (veyatmin hammappa im shear kele hechametz becheder sheeno ragil lelek lesham kol yeme happesach, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tn"a), veyashlik haqqinnuach vehapperurin haddaqqim bimqom derisat haraglayim apillu betok beto, dikshettaggia shaa shishshit kebar hen meboarin al yede derisat haraglayim. Abal im nisharu lo perurin gedolim, tzarik littenem lenokri bemattana gemura. Veap al pi sheasur litten beshabbat mattana sheen bah tzorek hashshabbat kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"v ayyen sham, mikkol maqom kevan shehu oseh ken kede lebaer hechametz mereshuto shello yaabor alayv bepesach be"bal yeraeh", hare yesh bintina zo tzorek mitzva, umuttar litten mattana letzorek mitzva kemo shennitbaer sham. Umikkol maqom, tzarik lizzaher shello yomar lo lehotzian mibbeto lemaqom sheasur letaltel bo beshabbat min hattora. Veap al pi shehu yodea shehannokri yotziennu veal menat ken hu noten, mikkol maqom kevan sheeno omer lo beperush sheyyotziennu, hare hannokri oseh ken middaat atzmo veeno shelucho shel yisrael. Veken tzarik lizzaher shello yitten lo ella dabar muat, dehaynu mezon seuda achat, sheim haya hannokri rotzeh haya yakol leoklah kullah bebet hayyisrael. Veim hotzio hannokri vechazar uba lebet hayyisrael, yakol lachazor velitten lo mezon seuda achat, veken apillu mea peamim. Abal asur litten lo bepaam achat yoter mimmezon seuda achat, dekevan sheeno yakol leekol kullo akshav bebet hayyisrael, hare nikkar haddabar shennoten lo al menat lehotzio, vahare keillu amar lo beperush lehotzio:

Vekol zeh keshehannokri motzio derek reshut harabbim sheasur letaltel bo min hattora, abal im hu motzio derek karmelit sheen issuro ella middibre soperim, muttar litten lo harbeh bebat achat, velomar lo beperush sheyyotziennu, shebbimqom mitzva hittiru lomar lenokri laasot beshabbat dabar sheen issuro ella middibre soperim, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"z:
Veim en nokri litten lo, o shekkebar higgia shaa shishshit sheasur littenah lenokri, yikpeh alayv keli ad motzae yom tob vibaarennu, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"v, ayyen sham kol perate din zeh:

Im shakach lehaprish challa beereb shabbat millechem chametz sheapa leshabbat zeh velo nizkar ad shechoshka lel shabbat, ap al pi sheim era ken bishar shabbetot hashshana yesh taqqana lelechem zeh im hu bechutz laaretz, shemmuttar leekol belo haprashat challa raq sheyyeshayyer mimmennu shiur challa veod mashshehu, kede shelleachar hashshabbat yaprish challa min hamshuyyar hazzeh gam al hallechem sheakal beshabbat, sheheqellu chakamim bechallat chutz laaretz lihyot okel veholek veachar kak maprish, abal beshabbat zeh i epshar laasot ken, shehare tzarik litten hamshuyyar hazzeh lenokri bemattana gemura qodem shettaggia shaa shishshit, veasur lo lehazhir et hannokri shello yoklennu vesheyyachazirennu lo leachar happesach kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tm"ch, veim lo yachazirennu lo hannokri leachar happesach lehaprish mimmennu challa nimtza shellemaprea akal tebel beshabbat zeh, lepikak en letebel zeh taqqana ella tzarik littenah kullah bemattana gemura lenokri qodem shaa shishshit:

Muttar letaltel chametz beshaa chamishit beshabbat zeh ap al pi sheeno rauy lo shehare hu asur baakila, mikkol maqom hare hu yakol lehaakilo libhema chayya veop o litteno lenokri, vahare dino kibsar nebela uterepa sheeno rauy ella lehaakilo liklabim o litteno lenokri, umuttar letaltelo beshabbat, kemo shennitbaer besiman shk"d ayyen sham. Abal mishshaa shishshit vaelak shehu asur bahanaa, hare hu muqtzeh keetzim vaabanim, kevan sheeno rauy lo liklum, ulepikak asur letaltelo apillu al yede dabar acher, kegon ledochopo beqaneh, ella im ken hu tzarik limqomo, sheaz muttar ledochopo beqaneh, kemo shennitbaer besiman shy"a. Abal ligga bo beyadayv asur apillu chal ereb pesach bimot hachol, ella beshaa shemmitasseq bo lebaaro min haolam, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tm"v, ayyen sham hattaam:

Apillu lo nishar lo shum chametz birshuto achar seudat shacharit shabbat zeh, ap al pi ken keshettaggia sop shaa chamishit tzarik lachazor ulebattel kol chametzo kederek shemmebattel bishar arbe pesachim, sheomer: "kol chamira vachamia deikka birshuti dachaziteh udela chaziteh ku'", kemo shennitbaer besiman tl"d:

Mi shehalak mibbeto bearbaa asar shacharit, ben shechal bechol ben shechal beshabbat, veqodem shehiggia zeman habbiur nizkar sheyyesh lo chametz betok beto shello biaro, veen dato lachazor lebeto ad leachar sheyyaggia zeman habbiur, im hu holek lidbar mitzva shezzemannah kol hayyom, kegon lamul et beno, o shehalak lisudat mitzva, kegon seudat mila upidyon habben, useudat erusin venissuin shel bat talmid chakam letalmid chakam ubat am haaretz leam haaretz, abal bat talmid chakam leam haaretz o bat kohen leyisrael kevan sheen zivvugan oleh yapeh enah niqret seudat mitzva, vaapillu hasseuda sheosin keshehechatan meshalleach siblonot lekallato sheqqorin otah seudat qinyan gam hi niqret seudat mitzva — en tzarik lachazor lebeto ulebaer hechametz, ella im ken yesh shehut bayyom sheyyachazor lebeto vibaer hechametz veyukal lachazor lelek uleqayyem hammitzva. Abal im en shehut bayyom kol kak — yebattelennu bammaqom shehu, shehare achar habbittul en tzarik lebaaro ella middibre soperim, ubimqom mitzva heemidu chakamim al dibre tora:

Abal im leachar shehiggia zeman habbiur nizkar sheyyesh lo chametz betok beto, sheaz eno yakol lebattelo kemo shennitbaer besiman tl"d — chayyab lachazor lebeto miyyad kede lebaer hechametz min haolam legamre im hu chol. Veap al pi sheachar kak lo yihyeh lo shehut lelek uleqayyem hammitzva, mikkol maqom en shum mitzvat aseh docha mitzvat aseh dehashbatat chametz, shehare kol rega verega sheeno mebaer hechametz hu ober al mitzvat aseh shel "tashbitu seor mibbattekem", mah sheen ken bishar kol mitzvot aseh. Chutz mimmet mitzva sheen lo qoberin vehu mutal al pene hassadeh bebizzayon, shekkol happogea bo chayyab leqobro miyyad, ap al pi shennizkar sheyyesh lo chametz betok beto vehu betok happesach sheeno yakol lebattelo vehu ober alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze", vaapillu yesh shehut bayyom sheyyukal lachazor lebeto ulebaer hechametz velachazor velelek uleqobro bo bayyom, ap al pi ken asur lo lazuz mimmennu ad sheyyiqberennu, sheggadol kebod habberiyyot sheddocheh et kol mitzvot shebbattora besheb veal taaseh (kelomar sheeno ober al lo taaseh bayyadayim, ella meeleha hi mitbattelet al yede shehu mitasseq biqburat hammet):

Haya holek lehatztzil min hannahar o min haddeleqa o min hammappolet o min hallistim, veqodem shehiggia zeman habbiur nizkar sheyyesh lo chametz betok beto, ap al pi sheyyesh shehut bayyom sheyyukal lachazor lebeto ulebaer hechametz velachazor velelek ulehatztzil, ap al pi ken lo yachazor lebeto, ella yebattel hechametz bammaqom shehu, dekevan shehu holek lehatztzalat nepashot heemidu chakamim al din tora shedday lo bebittul bilbad. Abal im nizkar achar shehiggia shaa shishshit, sheeno yakol lebattelo — tzarik lachazor lebeto lebaaro im yesh shehut bayyom sheyyukal lachazor velelek ulehatztzil. Vehu shebbari lo sheyyukal lehatztzil kol kak kesheyyelek achar kak kemo sheyyatztzil kesheyyelek akshav, abal im yesh lehistappeq shemma kesheyyelek akshav yukal lehatztzil yoter mimmah sheyyukal lehatztzil achar kak — lo yachazor lebeto, apillu hu betok happesach shehu ober alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze", lepi shekkol sepeq nepashot docheh apillu shabbat hachamura:

Veim holek lidbar hareshut venizkar sheyyesh lo chametz betok beto, apillu lo higgia adayin zeman habbiur, shehu yakol adayin lebattelo, ap al pi ken chayyab hu lachazor lebeto miyyad ulebaer kemitzvat chakamim, sheen dochin mitzvat chakamim mippene debar hareshut. Vaapillu hu holek lilmod tora etzel rabbo, hare zeh kidbar hareshut etzel biur chametz shehi mitzva middibre soperim, lepi shemmaaseh hammitzvot hu gadol mehattalmud keshei epshar leqayyem hammitzva al yede acherim. Veap al pi shemmitzvat hallimmud hu bekol rega verega, venimtza shebbaasiyyat mitzva middibre soperim hu mebattel mitzvat aseh shel talmud tora, vaapillu im gam hammitzva hi shel tora, hare shenehem shequlin veezeh sheyyirtzeh yaaseh, shekkol haoseq bemitzva patur mimmitzva acheret, mikkol maqom kevan shehammitzva hi oberet, sheim yaasoq battora velo yeqayyemenna titbattel hammitzva legamre, ubaasiyyat hammitzva lo titbattel mitzvat aseh shel tora legamre, shehare yakol lilmod achar kak, lepikak talmud tora nidcheh mippene kol hammitzvot apillu hen middibre soperim keshei epshar laasotan al yede acherim, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman rm"v:

Vaapillu holek lidbar hareshut mammash, en tzarik lachazor ella im ken yesh betok beto kebetza chametz, abal im en sham kebetza lo hitrichuhu chakamim lachazor miyyad, ella day lo bebittul im lo higgia shaa shishshit. Abal im higgia shaa shishshit, sheeno yakol lebattel — tzarik lachazor miyyad apillu en sham ella kezayit chametz, shehare kol zeman sheeno mebaaro min haolam legamre hu ober al mitzvat aseh shel tora. Abal im en sham ella pachot mikkezayit, sheeno ober alayv min hattora ella middibre soperim — lo hitrichuhu chakamim lachazor ap al pi sheeno yakol lebattelo, ella yelek ledarko ukesheyyachazor lebeto yebaaro miyyad beboo, veim hu yom tob o shabbat yikpeh alayv et hakkeli ad haereb, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tm"v:

Kebar nitbaer bekamma meqomot shemmishshehiggia shaa shishshit beereb pesach en adam yakol lebattel chametzo, lepi sheeno shello kevan shenneesar bahanaa. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshekkebar nitchammetz hechametz, abal qodem shennitchammetz yakol lebattelo kede shello yaabor be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze" min hattora leachar shennitchammetz. Lepikak, mi sheyyesh lo issa shel matztza betok beto mishshaa shishshit ulemala vehu tarud bemaqom acher vei epshar lo labo lebeto miyyad leepotah umityare shemma tachmitz ad sheyyachazor lebeto — yebattelenna qodem shettachmitz, shemmishshettachmitz en beyado lebattelah, veober alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze" min hattora.
